name: codex-workbench
description: Independent graphical Codex client: editor-tab conversations over the version-pinned App Server protocol. No terminal UI, no proprietary assets.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Spawns a local Codex agent backend with the workspace as cwd and can start coding turns. Requires a trusted workspace until a limited-trust mode exists.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:webview && node --test out/test/*.test.js
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check-protocol-pin && npm run build && npm run build:webview

commands.title: Codex Workbench: New Chat in Editor Tab
Codex Workbench: Attach Selection as Context

codexWorkbench.codexExecutablePath.description: Explicit path to the `codex` executable on the EXECUTION host (the machine running the workspace extension host). Empty = auto-discover. This setting is never transferred across Remote SSH boundaries: a local Windows path is never used on a remote Linux host.

codexWorkbench.approvalPolicy.description: Default approval policy sent on thread/start. The backend may narrow it; the UI always fails closed.
